items.prose: A day is an up day when its close is above the close before it. Number the days from 0, so day 1 is the first day that can be up.
items.question: Write `rising_days(closes)` that returns the list of up-day numbers, in order.

widget.starter:
def rising_days(closes):
    pass  # replace this line
widget.solution:
def rising_days(closes):
    return [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(closes, closes[1:]), start=1) if b > a]

explain.text: `zip(closes, closes[1:])` pairs each close with the next, `enumerate(..., start=1)` numbers the later day, and the `if` keeps the rises. A loop with `append` would do the same.
